name: carddown-workspace
description: CardDown workspace for Core, CLI, Studio, and Desktop.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @carddown/core && npm run build --workspace carddown
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/test-config.js && node scripts/test-theme.js && node scripts/test-security.js && node scripts/test-parser.js && node scripts/test-validation.js && node packages/cli/dist/index.js --help && node packages/cli/dist/index.js --list-themes --json
scripts.test:render: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js -i examples/test-math.md --json --output output/render-test-math --name render-test-math --scale 1 --no-cover && node packages/cli/dist/index.js -i examples/demo-numerical-analysis.md --theme claude-like-dark --output output/render-demo-dark --name render-demo-dark --scale 1
